info.name: Pioneer DDJ-800
info.author: Mix Two
info.description: MIDI mapping for the Pioneer DDJ-800, derived from the rekordbox MIDI message table. Untested on hardware.

option.label: Start in vinyl mode
option.description: Touching the top of the jog wheel scratches. The controller's own VINYL state overrides this once it reports it.

option.label: Jog resolution (ticks per revolution)
option.description: One full turn of the platter should move the track by 1.8 s, as on a record at 33 1/3 rpm. The DDJ-800 sends 6480 ticks per turn (measured against rekordbox). Increase if scratching moves the track too fast for the hand movement, decrease if it moves too slowly.

option.label: Input selector controls passthrough
option.description: When a channel's input selector is switched to LINE or PHONO, enable passthrough for that deck. Requires the matching input to be configured in Preferences > Sound Hardware.

option.label: MASTER, BOOTH and HEADPHONES knobs control Mix Two
option.description: The DDJ-800 changes MASTER LEVEL, BOOTH LEVEL and the HEADPHONES knobs only on its own outputs. Enable this when the mix goes through a different audio interface. Disable this when the mix goes through the DDJ-800 outputs. If you do not, the level changes two times.

option.label: DUB ECHO quick effect preset
option.description: Quick effect chain preset index loaded by the DUB ECHO button (-1 keeps the current preset).

option.label: SWEEP quick effect preset
option.description: Quick effect chain preset index loaded by the SWEEP button (-1 keeps the current preset).
